### Product defects

| card | from | severity (verifier) | owner | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **objectstack-ai/objectui#11626** | shell-nav-personalization A3 | P3 | objectui | grouped navigation offers no drag-reorder, and every stock app is grouped |
| **objectstack-ai/objectui#11627** | marketplace-console-honesty A3 | P3 | objectui | offline Details renders the Disabled card ahead of reseed / purge |
| **objectstack-ai/objectui#11629** | view-type-gallery A2 | P3 | objectui | kanban never reads `summarizeField` (declared-unenforced) |
| **objectstack-ai/objectui#11625** | grid-personalization A2 | P2 | objectui | the density PUT puts `rowHeight` at the envelope top level, and the server drops it with a 200 |
| **objectstack-ai/objectui#11632** | found in chart-type-matrix A8 | P3 | objectui | dataset `previousPeriod` comparison labelled "vs yesterday" |

None is a 17.7 regression: every defect above reproduces against console code unchanged since the 17.6.0 pin (`31971ff1e`) or earlier. No open duplicate was found for any of them.

### Checklist-accuracy findings (no fail attached; for the checklist owner)

1. **platform-core:**
   - home-admin-cluster-links and docs-portal-render: the personas say "fresh sign-up", which `invite_only` refuses. Docs step 4 should name the Help menu. `/apps/{pkg}/docs` lands on the reader of the first entry rather than on a separate listing.
   - home-admin-cluster-links: the item's whole Administration-cluster premise has no stable rendering surface at the pin (VF4), so it needs a revision beyond the parked clauses.
   - url-overlay-contract: the drawer list is the Review Queue page (`recordAction: 'drawer'`); `/forms/:name` takes view names (`showcase_task.form`); the child-create path is Account → Invoices tab → New.
   - theme-mode-persistence: the storage key is `object-ui-theme`, not `vite-ui-theme`, and ModeToggle lives in the avatar menu under Preferences.
   - shell-nav-personalization: pinned items appear under a "Favorites" heading, not "Pinned".
   - marketplace-console-honesty: reseed / purge live on `MarketplacePackagePage`, not on Installed Apps.
2. **api-backend:** api-console-discovery-execute: Realtime (`degraded`, `handlerReady:false`) gets no group, although the hook comment says degraded services "stay visible". This is the fail-closed direction.
3. **approvals:**
   - account-app-entry A7: the interface language is avatar menu → Language. The Profile "Preferred language" select sets only the notification language.
   - record-page-decisions: the mechanism text is stale. objectui#3055 / objectui PR #4077 retired `buildApprovalDecisionActions`, and the header renders the declared actions through DeclaredActionsBar. The visible set also includes Reassign / Send back / Request info / Recall, and A5 needs a non-override persona.
   - The inbox tabs are English by default ("My Pending" / "Submitted by me").
   - setup-packaged-automation-board A8: a member gets 403 on activation reads (also on 17.6.0), and reaches the page through other apps' component routes, not through Setup.
   - An invite with role "admin" is not honoured at sign-up; use `organization/update-member-role`.
   - The run's `steps_json` omits post-resume nodes, so branch-taken clauses cannot be read from the run.
4. **records-forms:**
   - list-view-capabilities:
     - A5 still names the retired string sort (`'estimate_hours desc'`, #17053), and the view now uses the array form.
     - A2 / A4 spell `$filter` / `$top` / `$skip` while the console sends `filter` / `top` / `skip`.
     - A9's `_selectedIds` is top-level, not under `params`.
     - A7 needs a knownGap: export is hidden on stock and the server answers 403 for admin.
   - view-type-gallery: `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` calls kanban "field-by-field wired", which is stale for `summarizeField`.
   - form-view-gallery: no console door opens the named form views; the wizard renders as steps only on the `/new` page route; the modal knownGap is partly stale (Task Desk renders a JSX modal form).
   - related-list-server-pagination: the knownGap is stale, because invite + sign-up + a permission-set row works.
   - gantt-interactions: the variants name a `lockField` that is not a spec key.
   - upload-guard-blocks-confirm: Confirm is relabelled "Uploading…" mid-flight.
   - adhoc-filter-sort-builder A3 verify: by design the sort is not restored, since only `{filters, search}` are stored.
   - saved-view-management step 1: create saves a draft and needs a publish.
   - bulk-select step 5: `top=0` gives `total:0`.
   - grid-personalization: the column-state key is `grid-columns-{object}` when the view has no `schema.id`.
   - calendar-interactions A4: the stock calendar cannot quick-create, because `project` is required.
   - conditional-rules-grid: INV-1002 ships a single line, so step 3 needs a seeded second line with a distinct position.
5. **dashboards:**
   - chart-type-matrix A3 cites combo `series[].type` / `series[].yAxis`, which were removed by the 2026-09-12 ruling. The compareTo probe recipe should add `dashboard.dateRange`, without which the executor refuses.
   - global-filters-rescope: Revenue Pulse's region filter uses static options, so D3's dataset-sourced half needs a scratch `optionsFrom` dashboard.
6. **i18n:**
   - notification-localized-and-clears step 2 is stale: `zh-CN` is accepted, and `sys_user.locale` exists. Its prescribed `zh` code is also what triggers the held date finding.
   - surface-matrix: the record-page knownGap and the variants string are stale, because the sections are named now. E11 needs a wait of more than 30 s after the tenant flip (`LOCALE_TTL_MS`).
   - studio-follows-app-locale names no Studio surface that carries a relative date.
7. **studio-authoring:**
   - packaged-automation-studio-lock: the knownGap ("objectui f7c52e2" shape) is stale (objectui#11124). A2 names 422 `writable_package_required`, but the live server answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` / `ITEM_LOCKED`.
   - packaged-display-class-direct-edit: the lock banner reads "This item is locked…", and Reset needs a native `confirm()` accepted.

Environment notes are in the record body.

## Re-run: the two held zh-date clauses (RUNNER rule 7)

The record held `i18n.surface-matrix` acceptance[0] (relative-dates variant) and `i18n.studio-follows-app-locale` acceptance[2] as FAIL, observed but not verified. A live re-run on the same subject (`316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`), 2 fresh boots × 2 loads plus controls, settles both:

| item | rev | was | now | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| i18n.surface-matrix | 4 | FAIL (held) | **PASS** | switching language through the avatar menu writes the user's locale (`zh-CN`); `/api/v1/auth/me/localization` answers `zh-CN`; every date formatter receives `zh-CN`; list dates render 10月15日 / 3天后 / 后天, record stamps 创建于: 8天前 |
| i18n.studio-follows-app-locale | 3 | FAIL (held) | **PASS** | same evidence; switching back writes `en` and restores "Oct 15" / "In 3 days" |

**Disposition of the original fail: invalid pairing.** The first lane set the UI language only in browser storage and never used the product's language switcher, so the user's stored locale stayed empty and dates followed the browser. No item step prescribes that, and the clauses are right as written.

**Corrected totals for this record: 40 PASS / 8 PARTIAL / 13 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN** (the title still shows the pre-re-run counts).

Close-out for these two clauses: no card. One candidate outside the clauses (when the language save fails, the UI language and the date locale can disagree; console, P3) is noted for the console owner and not extracted.

Optional step wording for both items (checklist owner): "use the avatar-menu language switcher (it writes the user's locale); seeding browser storage alone is not a language switch."
